title: Store a valid transcript event for one agency
description: This verifies that a valid transcript webhook for an agency is accepted and stored for later reporting.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/webhooks/vapi/agency-alpha
Fill a valid transcript event payload into the request body
Submit the webhook request
Verify a successful response is returned
Verify the transcript event is persisted for the agency

title: Keep transcript events isolated between agencies
description: This verifies that webhook events sent for different agency IDs are stored under the correct agency workspace without mixing data.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/webhooks/vapi/agency-alpha
Fill a valid transcript event payload for one call into the request body
Submit the webhook request
Navigate to /api/webhooks/vapi/agency-beta
Fill a valid transcript event payload for a different call into the request body
Submit the webhook request
Verify both requests are accepted successfully
Verify each transcript is stored only for its matching agency

title: Open the Live Calls dashboard from the sidebar
description: This verifies that an operator can use the sidebar to reach the Live Calls dashboard for active call monitoring.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard view
Open the dashboard sidebar
Click the Live Calls navigation entry
Verify the user reaches the Live Calls dashboard
Verify the LIVE badge is visible on the destination page

title: Show Live Calls entry in the sidebar
description: This verifies that an operator can see the Live Calls navigation item and the LIVE badge in the dashboard sidebar.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard view
Open the dashboard sidebar
Verify the Live Calls navigation entry is visible
Verify the LIVE badge is visible

title: Reject a malformed transcript payload without storing data
description: This verifies that an invalid transcript webhook is rejected and no transcript is stored.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/webhooks/vapi/agency-alpha
Fill a malformed webhook payload into the request body
Submit the webhook request
Verify an internal error response is returned
Verify no transcript event is persisted

title: Reject a non-transcript event without storing data
description: This verifies that webhook events that are not transcript messages are not accepted for persistence.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/webhooks/vapi/agency-alpha
Fill a webhook payload with a non-transcript message type into the request body
Submit the webhook request
Verify an internal error response is returned
Verify no transcript event is persisted

title: Stay on the current view when Live Calls is unavailable
description: This verifies that when the Live Calls navigation item is unavailable, the user does not navigate away from the current dashboard view.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard view
Open the dashboard sidebar
Wait for the Live Calls navigation item to be unavailable
Verify the Live Calls destination is not reached
Verify the current dashboard view remains visible
